cases.duty: Mixed positive package: every collection exercised; all three judges, all eight verdict enums, two source scopes, a stored-only extra extension, an unassigned-origin record, one note, two reviews and one session are admitted without silent normalization; difficulty is absent on one problem and present on another.
cases.note: PW-N08 (identity re-check: re-checking PW-P01 must report the same --identity SHA-256) is a checker self-test handled by a sibling PR, not a separate file. PW-N12 (origin:'unassigned' accepted but never attributed to the importing account) is a positive property asserted here via the luogu.P1001 record. The spec says 'attempts from two sourcePlatforms'; manifest-level sourcePlatform is necessarily single, so this is represented by two distinct sourceScopeId values (scope.alpha, scope.beta) across the eight attempts. synthetic:true is marked inside the extra extension where the schema permits provenance.

cases.duty: A future major version is a whole-package reject, never best-effort decoded.

cases.duty: A 27000 UTF-8-byte string exceeds the 16 KiB byte bound even though its code-point length is under the schema maxLength.

cases.duty: A path-shaped string in a free-text field is rejected as defense in depth; v1 has no file fields.

cases.duty: An unknown verdict is a rejection, not a coercion to OTHER.
A credential-shaped key (token) anywhere, including under extra, is rejected; credentials are never portable.
